name: Shenyang Shengjing Assets Management Group Co., Ltd. (沈阳盛京资产管理集团有限公司)
via: a wholly state-owned company established by the Shenyang municipal party committee and government in July 2017, with the Shenyang municipal SASAC performing the state's investor duties (per a company profile carried by China Industry News/Sohu, 2025-10-28, and the Shenyang SASAC's own recruitment notices)
note: State-capital operating company of Shenyang city, RMB 5 billion registered capital; its sectors include commercial retail through Shengjing Department Store (盛京百货).
